entities.summary: Jesse Gregory James is an American entrepreneur, automotive mechanic, and television personality. He is the founder of West Coast Choppers, ex-partner of Austin Speed Shop, and CEO of Jesse James Firearms Unlimited, also based in Austin, Texas.
